items.title: How gray can error text get before it fails WCAG?
items.description: The audit's error text failed at 2.3:1 and passed once darkened to 5.9:1. Drag the text color slider (a gray value on white background) and watch the actual contrast ratio, computed with the same WCAG relative-luminance formula from this unit, against the AA (4.5:1) and AAA (7:1) thresholds.
items.compute: const c = params.textGray / 255; const lin = c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); const L = 0.2126 * lin + 0.7152 * lin + 0.0722 * lin; const ratio = (1.0 + 0.05) / (L + 0.05); return { ratio: Math.round(ratio * 100) / 100 };

items.title: How much does target size affect mis-tap rate?
items.description: This is an illustrative model, not measured field data, showing why WCAG 2.5.5 recommends a 44×44 CSS px minimum: smaller tap targets demand more positional precision, which increases mis-taps for anyone with limited fine motor control or a tremor. Drag the target size and watch the modeled error rate fall.
items.compute: const errorRate = 100 * Math.exp(-params.targetSize / 30); return { errorRate: Math.round(errorRate * 10) / 10 };
